name: EPIC 247350835

text.card: A red giant 3,350 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.05 solar masses and 10.4 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,804 K at its surface.
